method.definition: Successful malloc/calloc/aligned-allocation and realloc requests intercepted by glibc mtrace. Realloc contributes its full requested new size, not the size delta.
method.scope: Steady-state API calls and returned-value destruction. Fixture construction, warm-up, tracing startup/shutdown and JSON reporting are outside the traced window.
method.limits: Requested bytes are cumulative and exclude allocator metadata; they are not peak memory, RSS or retained bytes. Direct mmap and allocations bypassing glibc malloc hooks are not counted. No traced latency is reported.

native_trace_archive.contents: All 30 original .trace files; member names match each trace path basename. Timestamps and ownership are normalized in the archive, not the trace bytes.

verification.timing_validation_note: Final 826 full-API records independently match the measured native binary paths, sizes, SHA-256 values and implementation/tree identities; all three candidate artifacts also match artifact-builds-final.json. No traced latency is used.
verification.note: Counts were independently recomputed from raw mtrace tokens without reusing the driver parser.
